description: Canonical Coach Boss Feedback Catalog and Dynamic Rule Repository. Contains persistent clinical, culinary, and physical print rules.

rules.name: Rice Cake Maximum Portion Cap
rules.description: Rice cakes (C020) must never exceed 4 cakes (35-40g) per meal to prevent gastric distension and volumetric bloat.
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: No Plain Legume Stacking on Traditional Stews
rules.description: When composite legume stews (Shiro R001, Misir Wot R002, Kik Alicha R003) are planned, forbid plain boiled lentils (P001) or boiled ful (P007) in the same meal.
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: Injera Portions Strict 60g Increments
rules.description: Every single Injera (C001) portion across all 7 days must be strictly locked to clean multiples of 60g (60g, 120g, 180g, 240g) with matched Amharic familiar measure.
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: Soya Chunks Standard Household Measure
rules.description: Dry soy chunks (P009) must consistently display 'በግምት 1 ከግማሽ ሲኒ የተዘፈቀ' as familiar household measure to prevent raw/soaked dry weight confusion.
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: Traditional Stew Standard Portions
rules.description: Traditional stews must use standard cultural ladle portions: Atkilt Wot (R004) -> 80g; Misir Wot (R002) -> 200g; Ful (R018, R025) -> 220g.
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: Fasting Breakfast Oats Liquid Balance
rules.description: When fasting breakfast contains Oats (C007) and Peanut Butter (T004): cap PB to 12g (cutting) or 15g (balanced); cap Oats to 40g (cutting) or 50g (balanced); inject Soy Milk (P014) at 200g/250g.
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: No Loose Oil on Oil-Rich Stews
rules.description: Key Wot (R020), Minchet Abish (R023), and rich stews already contain ample cooking oil. Forbid adding loose cooking oil (T001) to these meals.
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: Breakfast Cooking Oil Maximum Cap
rules.description: Breakfast cooking oil (T001) cannot exceed 15g to avoid excessive early morning fat saturation.
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: Proportional Fasting Day Protein Floor
rules.description: On fasting days, daily protein must achieve at least 78% of target protein (or 135g for hardgainers >= 2800 kcal).
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: Zero Nested Parentheses in Rendered Text
rules.description: Prevent visual formatting glitches such as double parentheses ((...)) or (በግምት ... (በግምት ...)) across all meal item familiar descriptions.
rules.author: Coach Hilawe

rules.name: No Fried Eggs with Peanut Butter at Breakfast
rules.description: Forbids pairing fried eggs with peanut butter in breakfast meals due to culinary incompatibility and heavy digestive burden from combined saturated fats and dense nut lipids.
rules.author: Coach Boss
